description: Unique alphanumeric identifier for property record in Jammu dataset
derivation_method: Sequential prefix formatting (JMU0001 - JMU1200)
missing_policy: Mandatory primary key; reject record if null or duplicate

description: Classification of property asset
derivation_method: Direct listing extraction; standard category mapping
missing_policy: Impute with mode of locality or flag as Unknown

description: Super built-up / plot area in square feet
derivation_method: Observed or converted from area_marla * 272.25
missing_policy: Compute from area_marla if available; else median by property_type

description: Area in local land measurement unit Marla (1 Marla = 272.25 sq ft in Jammu)
derivation_method: area_sqft / 272.25

description: Area in regional land measurement unit Kanal (1 Kanal = 20 Marlas = 5,445 sq ft)
derivation_method: area_marla / 20.0

description: Property unit asking price per square foot
derivation_method: Listed unit price or (total_price_lakh * 100000) / area_sqft

description: Unit asking price per Marla in Lakhs INR
Total asking price in Lakhs INR
derivation_method: (area_sqft * price_per_sqft) / 100000.0

description: Age of the property structure in years relative to base year 2026
derivation_method: 2026 - year_built
missing_policy: Compute from year_built; if plot set to 0

description: Binary flag indicating whether property is situated on a corner plot
derivation_method: Listing feature flag parsing

description: Cardinal or intercardinal facing direction of main entrance
unit: Compass (East, West, North, South, North-East, South-West)
derivation_method: Listing attribute extraction

description: Width of access road fronting the property in feet
derivation_method: Listing specs or JDA layout sector plan
missing_policy: Median road width by locality and property type (typically 12-20 ft)

description: Standardized geographic neighborhood in Jammu (36 canonical levels)
derivation_method: Canonical alias harmonization via lookup table
missing_policy: Mandatory geographic anchor; drop or geocode if missing
join_key: Locality join key across JDA, JMC, SDMA, OSM, Revenue

description: Straight-line / road distance from property/locality to Jammu City Center (Jewel Chowk)
derivation_method: Haversine distance from centroid (lat, lon) to (32.7266, 74.8570)

description: Distance from property/locality to nearest National/State Highway (NH-44)
derivation_method: Spatial distance calculation to NH-44 corridor segment
missing_policy: Compute from OSM highway vector line

description: Aggregated locality desirability score based on demand and commercial infrastructure
derivation_method: Composite index based on price trends and amenities

description: Composite score reflecting municipal roads, drainage, lighting, and power infrastructure
derivation_method: Average of road, drainage, and utility readiness

description: Quality and lane capacity of road network connecting locality to arterial roads
derivation_method: Proximity to 4-lane corridors and internal access width

description: Accessibility to Matador/bus routes, auto stands, and railway station
derivation_method: Density of public transit stops within 1 km buffer

description: Number of recognized primary and secondary schools within 2 km radius
derivation_method: Point-in-buffer spatial aggregation from OSM nodes

description: Number of hospitals, nursing homes, and primary health centres within 3 km radius
derivation_method: Point-in-buffer spatial aggregation from OSM healthcare nodes

description: Tenure and title type of land ownership
derivation_method: Revenue title classification
missing_policy: Mode by locality; high risk if State Land without lease deed

description: Legal instrument of transfer / registration
unit: Registered Sale Deed, Power of Attorney (GPA), Mutation Pending
derivation_method: Document category at registration

description: Whether property/layout has statutory planning permission from Jammu Development Authority
derivation_method: Cross-match with JDA layout approval master gazette
missing_policy: False if unverified in JDA approved colony list

description: Eligibility for retail home loans / mortgage financing from scheduled commercial banks
derivation_method: Verification of title search clarity and building bye-law sanction
missing_policy: Derived as False if registry is GPA or State Land without JDA approval

description: Name of developer, housing firm, or individual seller
derivation_method: Extracted from listing or project registration
missing_policy: Categorize as 'Local Individual Seller' if unnamed
join_key: Builder join key with RERA registers

description: Reputational credibility rating derived from track record and RERA compliance
derivation_method: RAG synthesis based on past delivery timeliness, complaint count, and litigation
missing_policy: Default to 5.0 (neutral baseline) for unlisted individual sellers

description: Reported municipal complaints regarding drainage, sanitation, or encroachment in locality
derivation_method: Locality ward-level complaint frequency

description: Environmental flood susceptibility zone classification
derivation_method: Spatial intersection of property locality with Tawi river flood maps
missing_policy: Classify by locality baseline; Low for elevated Jammu plateaus

description: Availability of dedicated JPDCL grid electricity feeder line
derivation_method: Utility verification flag
missing_policy: Default to True for urban Jammu localities

description: Availability of underground municipal sewerage network
derivation_method: Ward-level sewer master plan mapping

description: Piped tap water reliability score (Jal Shakti Department supply)
derivation_method: Supply hours and pressure consistency rating

description: Historical compound annual capital appreciation rate over preceding 5 years
Model / expert forecasted appreciation over subsequent 3 years
derivation_method: Trend projection from past growth and infrastructure momentum
field_status: Observed in raw / Target in modeling
missing_policy: Target field; do not impute arbitrarily

description: Ground truth investment suitability label
derivation_method: Composite rule threshold based on buy-worthiness index
missing_policy: Target label; reject record if missing in training

description: Ratio of property asking price to median asking price of same property type in same locality
derivation_method: price_per_sqft / median(price_per_sqft for same locality & property_type)
missing_policy: Default to 1.0 if locality-type median unavailable

description: Ratio of property asking price to citywide median asking price for same property type
derivation_method: price_per_sqft / citywide_median(price_per_sqft for same property_type)

description: Differential between forecasted 3-year growth and historical 5-year growth
derivation_method: forecast_3yr_price_growth_pct - past_5yr_price_growth_pct

description: Normalized composite index of title safety (JDA approval, registered deed, loan approval, freehold)
derivation_method: Weighted sum: 0.35*(registry=='Registered Sale Deed') + 0.25*jda_approved + 0.25*bank_loan_approved + 0.15*(ownership=='Freehold')

description: Normalized composite index of access to education, healthcare, transit, and city center
derivation_method: Min-max normalized weighted combination of schools, hospitals, transit, and inverse distance

description: Normalized composite index of civic liability (complaints, flood hazard, lack of water/sewer/power)
derivation_method: Weighted sum of normalized complaints, flood risk scale, and inverted utility scores

description: Percentile rank of locality median price per sqft relative to all 36 Jammu localities
derivation_method: Locality median price percentile ranking across Jammu market
